findings.issue: `navigate()` reads `window.location.search` to merge params while a debounced search timer and router.replace transitions may be in flight; concurrent updates can drop or resurrect query params (known App Router fragility, cf. vercel/next.js#92187)
findings.suggestion: Derive the full param set from the `q`/`type`/`generation` props plus the local term state, and build the URL from those instead of reading window.location

findings.issue: Descending sort reverses the whole ascending array, which also inverts the move-name tie-break order within equal keys
findings.suggestion: Sort with a direction-aware comparator instead of reversing, so the tie-break stays stable

findings.issue: `apiJson` returns null on 404, but `record.name`/`record.type` are dereferenced without a guard, so a single missing move record crashes the page
findings.suggestion: Filter out null records (or fall back to humanized name) before building rows

findings.issue: Reusable card component imports `apiUrl` from the server-only `lib/api.js`, leaking the server data layer into a shared component
findings.suggestion: Move `apiUrl` (a one-line URL joiner) into `lib/format.js` or a shared constants module

findings.issue: `force-dynamic` on every route plus `cache: 'no-store'` in the fetch wrapper are redundant; both opt out of caching, and Next 16's recommended model is now Cache Components (`use cache`)
findings.suggestion: Keep one mechanism (the segment config), and consider migrating to `cacheComponents` + `use cache` with `cacheLife` when touching this next

findings.issue: No `error.jsx`/`global-error.jsx` boundary, so an API failure (non-404) surfaces Next's stock 500 page with no way back
findings.suggestion: Add a minimal `error.jsx` with a retry action and a link home

findings.issue: Build output directory sits inside the app with no `.gitignore` entry (root .gitignore doesn't cover it)

summary: A well-shaped Next 16 App Router app: server components everywhere except two justified client islands, awaited async params, metadata API, proper notFound handling, and a deliberate spec-compliant in-memory data cache. The real merge blockers are absent; the notable fragility is the search controls reading `window.location.search` across in-flight router transitions, which can drop or resurrect filter params. I'd approve after one round of small fixes.
